title: Editable Integer Interval Set
instructions:
Implement `IntervalSet` in `interval_set.py`. It stores integer half-open intervals:
`[start, end)` includes start but excludes end. Inputs are integers; no type checking is required.

- `IntervalSet()` creates an empty set.
- `add(start: int, end: int) -> None` unions an interval into the set. Merge overlapping
  intervals AND touching intervals into a single interval.
- `remove(start: int, end: int) -> None` subtracts an interval, splitting stored intervals
  when necessary. Removing absent values is harmless.
- Both mutations raise `ValueError` for start > end without changing state. Equal endpoints
  are a no-op.
- `contains(value: int) -> bool` reports membership.
- `intervals() -> list[tuple[int, int]]` returns a new list of the nonempty stored intervals,
  sorted by start. Modifying the returned list must not change the set.
Negative endpoints are supported; there are no endpoint size limits.

## Files
- `interval_set.py`
